purpose: Matched incremental Arrow reads and four-reader ADBC explicit-range diagnostic
binary_note: Same SHA-256 as the #422 wide-transfer client comparison. Production source equivalence is recorded in the original hash-slice-arrow and stream-byte-budget manifests. Later main changes are not included.

server.persistence: AOF disabled, automatic RDB snapshots disabled

host_note: Shared macOS arm64 workstation (18 logical CPUs, 36 GiB). Other workloads were not stopped; unrelated benchmark containers were observed idle before the run. Results apply to this interleaved local experiment.
schedule: One warmup per case followed by six measured rounds. Forward/reverse case order alternates, balancing three rounds in each order.
timing: First normalized Arrow batch and first IPC flush use a common producer-side measurement boundary. Total includes fresh worker startup/imports, connections, planning, full reads, Arrow conversion, IPC output and shutdown. Exact source validation is outside timing.
explicit_ranges_note: Externally supplied dense row-ID intervals on an immutable fixture; no partition planner. This is a benchmark application pattern, not a change to production driver APIs, a snapshot guarantee or a general replacement for discovery.
smoke_status: All complete values and row multiplicities passed.
smoke_runner_note: Smoke runner differs only by the absence of UTC started_at/completed_at metadata and its datetime import. Reconstructed historical bytes match the smoke runner SHA-256; canonical results match the committed runner exactly.
